hero.tagline: Learn how to effectively manage blockchain projects — combining PM best practices with blockchain's technical, regulatory, and stakeholder demands, from scoping through quality, change, and project closing.

section1.title: Introduction to Blockchain Projects Management
section1.description: The elements of blockchain projects, project vs. product management, the delivery checklist, Agile vs. Waterfall, and stakeholder management.

section2.title: Project Planning & Scoping for Blockchain
section2.description: SMART objectives, the on-chain/off-chain boundary, WBS and the backlog fork, per-work-package tailoring, estimation, schedules, and AI-enabled planning tools.

section3.title: Risk Management in Blockchain Projects
section3.description: Risk principles, the four blockchain risk categories, assessment and prioritization, mitigation and contingency strategies, and the living risk register.

section4.title: Communication & Collaboration for Blockchain Teams
section4.description: Communicating with technical and non-technical stakeholders, lifecycle protocols, incident communication, and collaboration tool selection.

section5.title: Leading Blockchain Project Teams
section5.description: The role of the blockchain PM, building trust in distributed teams, leadership styles, agile leadership, and conflict resolution.

section6.title: Beyond Planning & Execution
section6.description: Quality management, the irreversible-commitment gate, monitoring and evaluation, change control, and project closure with transition to operations.

conclusion.title: Conclusion
conclusion.description: The blockchain PM is not just a project manager — they are the translator between the technical and the human.
